Consider a project management tool that allows users to create and manage tasks. The interface provides multiple ways to interact with the system: users can add tasks via a detailed form, use drag-and-drop functionality to create tasks on a visual board, or use keyboard shortcuts for quick task entry. Advanced users can also customize their workspace layout and save presets for different project types. Which of the following UI evaluation heuristics is demonstrated in this scenario?

An event planning app allows users to organize schedules, send invites, and track RSVPs. However, the app uses a very unique set of icons and labels for its features, which are hard to recall for users who don’t use the app frequently. Users often struggle to access key features or complete tasks like editing guest lists or viewing event details after not using the app for a while. What kind of usability goal is missing from the mobile app?

Which of the following is/are true about designing test cases for blackbox testing?
options: Test cases are designed to examine only the input and output values.
Designing test cases necessitates access to the source code.
No knowledge of the underlying design or code required
The structure of the program needs to be analyzed using some heuristics.
correct_answer: Test cases are designed to examine only the input and output values.
No knowledge of the underlying design or code required

options: Developers commit the code to a continuous integration server.
After each commit, the continuous integration server pulls the new code from the version control system.

questions.text: Which of the following is/are the primary task/s of sales team in a software organization?
options: Conduct market research and look for opportunities in the market
Sell the product it to users that marketing team has identified
Provide feedback to marketing, product, and design teams regarding the product, which engineers then address.
correct_answer: Sell the product it to users that marketing team has identified
Provide feedback to marketing, product, and design teams regarding the product, which engineers then address.

questions.text: In today's world, where software development occurs in distributed environments, it is crucial for developers to create precise interface definitions. Based on the provided options, which statement(s) regarding interface definitions is/are correct?
options: It describes the capabilities of a function.
It provides the implementation details of a function.
It tells which requests are allowed and how the output will be formatted.
The code implementing the interface should remain unchanged until the interface remains the same.
correct_answer: It describes the capabilities of a function.
It tells which requests are allowed and how the output will be formatted.
